what_happened: The operator wrote nine requests by hand and queued them. They covered job planning build 1, a retry fix, four jobs to ready the study for a second system, the design-surface measure and design-review role, and the first layer of the cohesive spec. Each request carried the requirements, plan and acceptance that a planning stage in Athena would produce. The operator did this because Athena does not yet plan its own work (OP-17), and queued the requests so the plan would be in Athena's records instead of the operator's scratch files. No job failed. The operator also still decides the order of work. This is an intervention.
cause: Athena has no stage between a short outcome request and the producer that turns the outcome into requirements, a plan, acceptance and an order of work. The operator is therefore the only place where that design can happen, and it is done again for every batch. Queuing the plans in Athena's records makes them traceable, but it does not move the judgment into Athena. The operator also still owns sequencing, so Athena has no way to prioritise its own queue. The work stays manual until the planning stage lands.
prevention: Build the job-planning stage. It takes a short outcome request and produces requirements, a plan, behavioral acceptance criteria and a proposed order, records them with the job, and has the operator approve or amend them. Until it lands, log each hand-written batch as one intervention and record the planning work as a deliverable of the planning job, so the interventions can be counted and retired.
proposed_request: Build job planning so that a one-or-two-line outcome request is turned by Athena into requirements, a plan, behavioral acceptance criteria and a proposed priority order, all stored in the job's records for the operator to approve or amend before the producer starts. Show it working by submitting the outcome-only forms of the nine requests queued on 2026-10-17 (job planning build 1, the retry fix, the four second-system study jobs, the design-surface measure and design-review role, and the first layer of the cohesive spec). The plans it produces should cover what the operator wrote by hand, with no operator-written method in the requests.
